# participation interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:participationInterval`](gmeow-participationInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/participationInterval>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

The time interval over which the participation held. (A relator carries its period this way — matching [`usageInterval`](gmeow-usageInterval.md) / [`relationshipInterval`](gmeow-relationshipInterval.md) — rather than via [`duringInterval`](gmeow-duringInterval.md).)
